figures.finding: No person may employ a child (under sixteen) in any occupation, a child helping a parent's family business in light work outside school hours aside; the Act makes no exception for performing, so a child performer under sixteen may not be employed (a reading; the Children's Act 2020 wasn't read); a young person (sixteen to seventeen) may not work between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m. nor in work harmful to his development; the same reaches writing or directing work.

sources.said: No person shall employ a child for employment or work in any occupation.
“child” means a person under the age of 16;
No person shall employ a young person in an undertaking between 10 p.m. and 5 a.m..

figures.finding: A person of sixteen or more may enter a work agreement and is deemed of full age and capacity for it and its enforcement; no share of earnings is set aside; the rule reaches any work agreement, writing and directing included.

value.binding: own capacity from 16 for a work agreement (s. 10)

sources.said: A person who is of the age of 16 or more shall be competent to enter into an agreement and shall, in relation to the agreement and to its enforcement, be deemed to be of full age and capacity.

figures.finding: The Film Rebate Scheme is open only to production companies incorporated or registered in Mauritius, from producers with at least five years' successful track record; a person applies through his company.

value.applicant: production company incorporated or registered in Mauritius

sources.said: The Film Rebate Scheme will be available to production companies incorporated or registered in Mauritius, including those with 100% foreign ownership;
only applications from producers with a successful track record of at least 5 years in film production will be entertained;
